title: CHORD: Cross-Model Hallucination Detection via Relational Graph Discrimination
abstract: arXiv:2610.38314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hallucination detection is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) in real-world applications. Due to strong empirical performance, internal representation-based methods have emerged as the prevailing direction for detecting hallucinations, yet they remain largely model-specific and often fail to generalize to unseen LLMs. In this paper, we study an important yet underexplored problem, termed cross-model hallucination detection (CMHD), which aims to train hallucination detectors on source LLMs while ensuring performance on unseen target LLMs. The core challenge of CMHD lies in cross-model representation heterogeneity: hidden states from different LLMs exhibit severe semantic inconsistency, which limits the transferability of classical representation-based detectors. translated_title: CHORD：基于关系图判别的跨模型幻觉检测
translated_abstract: 幻觉检测对于大语言模型（LLM）在实际应用中的部署至关重要。由于经验性能出色，基于内部表示的方法已成为检测幻觉的主流方向，但它们在很大程度上仍然局限于特定模型，且往往无法泛化到未见过的LLM上。在本文中，我们研究了一个重要但尚未被充分探索的问题，称为跨模型幻觉检测（CMHD），其目标是在源LLM上训练幻觉检测器，同时确保其在未见过的目标LLM上的性能。CMHD的核心挑战在于跨模型表示的异构性：来自不同LLM的隐藏状态表现出严重的语义不一致性，这限制了经典基于表示的检测器的可迁移性。通过分析和实证验证，我们展示了跨层、token和特征的关系结构能够捕获可迁移的检测信号，尽管语义上……
tldr: 本文提出了跨模型幻觉检测（CMHD）这一新问题，并提出了CHORD方法，通过利用层、token和特征之间的关系图结构来克服不同LLM之间表示的异构性，使在源模型上训练的幻觉检测器能够有效泛化到未见过的目标模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces cross-model hallucination detection (CMHD) and proposes CHORD, which leverages relational graph structures over layers, tokens, and features to overcome representation heterogeneity across LLMs, enabling hallucination detectors trained on source models to generalize to unseen target models.
